- 9 × 99999999 = 899999991
- 99 × 9999999 = 989999901
- 999 × 999999 = 998999001

Their sum is 3888888894. The splits with the longer piece on the left just repeat these products, so there are exactly four distinct results.

The digit sum is wrong in the proposed solution. The number 3888888894 has 10 digits, which are 3, seven 8s, 9, and 4. The solution counted eight 8s and added an extra term, which gives 3 + 56 + 9 + 4 = 72.
